title: On a hypergraph Turán problem of Balogh-Bohman-Bollobás-Zhao
summary: Let $S$ and $T$ be disjoint sets with $|S|=i$ and $|T|=r-1$ for $2\le i\le r-1$, and let $B_i^{(r)}$ be the $r$-graph on $S\cup T$ whose edges are the $r$-subsets containing $S$ or $T$. We study the deficit $q_{r,i}:=1-π(B_i^{(r)})$ in its Turán density. Balogh, Bohman, Bollobás, and Zhao previously obtained bounds for these deficits with logarithmic gaps near both ends of the sequence $B_i^{(r)}$, namely, when $i=O(1)$ or $i=r-O(1)$.
